title: Camp-survival model: log predicted vs actual camp damage, then test a tank model (nearest champion takes the hits, no negative reserve) (P_LOGCAMP, P_CAMPMODEL)
source: Javi's review of the study27-economy branch, 16 Oct 07:00 UTC
hypothesis: step 1: the logged actual damage of the front champion is above the old prediction; step 2: fewer camp deaths and bails, farm speed not worse

history.result: data: front takes 67-81% and beats the old prediction in 35-42% of squads; every cautious model loses (tank 4-21, tank at camp 15-36, reserve -30 10-25)
